content.comment_body: Hello, in connection references, it seems you're unable to disconnect the connection. After saving a diagram as shown in the image and uploading it to [product_name], it doesn't function correctly. Thank you for your feedback.
Your counter is not working, so timer [article_no] never activates, causing Q1 to remain inactive. You've done this twice. Can you explain the purpose of this program?
This is just an example. For clarity in a larger program, I placed a separate joint reference. Afterward, reference 0 was not loaded.

There's a bug in the [product_name] software. If an analog reference line is disconnected and the chart is saved, re-opening the chart and starting the simulation causes the reference to fail. Only reconnecting the separated reference restores functionality. This issue has already been noted in posts on the German forum.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing a software issue where disconnecting and saving an analog reference line in [product_name] leads to malfunctions. Upon reopening and simulating the diagram, the reference does not operate unless it is manually reconnected, resulting in workflow disruptions and confusion about program behavior after such actions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that analog reference connections, when separated and saved, will be retained and function properly after reopening and simulating or uploading the diagram.
